what: 165 defects live in mruby 4.0.0-rc2 by differential test extraction, classified by four native arms and run in a Capstone domain

window.rule: a commit touching both a source file and a Ruby test file; the lines it added to the test become the case

advisory_route.cve_ghsa: 44 published for mruby, 43 already fixed at the pin; the one live (CVE-2026-79590, a NULL to memcpy in Prism) is not a reuse defect
advisory_route.reading: the pin is recent, so its live defects are the ones found after it; upstream's own regression tests are the instrument that reaches them

sweep.control: the twelve rows the GC-slot corpus found by hand are all 12 rediscovered; 0cf969a2b only once the window runs to master rather than to the port's head pin, its fix having landed the day after that pin

asan_page1_only_rows: 628ccec60 (mruby-task does not mark the main task's values)
native_classification.stress_note: MRB_GC_STRESS changes no verdict, so no row depends on a collection at every allocation

domain.arm: level0, the port's default heap: pointers carry the ARENA's bounds (CAPSTONE_LEVEL0_SHRINK, which narrows to each object, is opt-in and off here), tags are enforced, and free only marks. It is the control for the revoking arms, so a fault is the defect reaching a tag or arena check, not a revocation catch
domain.watchdog: 45 s per case, implemented in the guest loop because this guest has no timeout(1); three of the four killed cases loop forever at the pin natively too
domain.silent_to_trap_note: for these six the native build returns a wrong answer with no diagnostic and the domain traps. What traps is tag integrity and the arena's bounds, not per-object bounds: a capability rebuilt from an integer or derived from a dead one carries no tag, and an access that leaves the arena faults

arms: sublet-gc (every GC object slot issued and revoked on its own)
revoking_arms_blocked.verdict: neither can report anything about this corpus: both fail their own control
revoking_arms_blocked.bracket: one recursion depth per run, the same script in all three arms: level0 completes at 20, 40, 60, 100, 200 and 500 frames; sublet and sublet-gc complete at 20 and fault at 40 and above
revoking_arms_blocked.reading: the VM stack's repeated growth under the buddy heap, between 20 and 40 frames of Ruby recursion, independent of this corpus. The GC-slot corpus records the same wall at stack_extend_alloc

platform.native: x86-64, gcc, the pin's own tree; four builds from probe/corpus_config.rb with the port's gem set

not_measured: no case is cut to the corpus schema; cases is 0 and the corpus is triaged
no domain fault is attributed to a defect yet: that needs the matched pair, the pin plus that one fix, which must stop faulting

24 further defects are live at the pin with a reproducer in their issue rather than in a test, the mruby-task assertion lane among them (#6862, #6863, #6868, #6870, #6886, #6887); extract.py cannot see them and they are not in the 165
